codes.label: Document reading first
codes.description: The participant reads the tutorial before any code-writing step.

codes.label: Incremental construction
codes.description: The participant evaluates after adding one behavior-affecting statement since the previous evaluation.

codes.label: Local revision
codes.description: After evaluating, the participant changes less than a full statement and evaluates again.

codes.label: Local revision after a syntax error
codes.description: A sub-statement revision follows an evaluation with a syntax error.

codes.label: Local revision after wrong output
codes.description: A sub-statement revision follows an evaluation with obviously wrong output.

codes.label: Trial-and-error testing
codes.description: After reading an error, the participant attempts at least two revisions and evaluations.

codes.label: Syntax-to-semantics progression
codes.description: A revision resolves a syntax error, after which the participant does not revise a behavioral problem.

codes.label: Pastes documentation example
codes.description: The participant pastes example code copied from documentation.

codes.label: Paste is first edit
codes.description: The first code-editing step is a paste.

codes.label: Deletes paste before repasting
codes.description: The participant deletes a paste before editing it and then pastes another piece of code.

codes.label: Incomplete token
codes.description: An evaluated program contains an appropriate lexical element that is incomplete.

codes.label: Wrong token
codes.description: An evaluated program contains a token that is invalid or inappropriate at its location.

codes.label: Token from another language
codes.description: The problematic token or form comes from another familiar programming language.

codes.label: Token not from the language
codes.description: The problematic token or form is not part of this language.

codes.label: Incorrect value
codes.description: A value is syntactically usable but incorrect for the intended behavior.

codes.label: Variable, identifier, or field issue
codes.description: The evaluation fails because a variable, identifier, or field is incomplete or incorrect.

codes.label: Incorrect binding
codes.description: A name or resource is bound incorrectly.

codes.label: Incorrect declaration
codes.description: A declaration is incomplete or incorrect.

codes.label: Incorrect reference
codes.description: A program refers to a value, object, or resource incorrectly.

codes.label: Incomplete structure
codes.description: An evaluated program is missing a token or formatting required to complete a program structure.

codes.label: Incorrect arrangement
codes.description: Required components exist but are nested, ordered, organized, or scoped incorrectly.

codes.label: Valid syntax but incorrect output
codes.description: The program executes successfully but its output does not satisfy the task.

codes.label: Translating task requirements
codes.description: Difficulty converting width, cast-on, securing rows, releasehook, and body rows into a complete structure.

codes.label: Repairing structure and syntax
codes.description: Repeated revision of block boundaries, direction scopes, statements, or loop nesting before compilation.

codes.label: Constructing a valid cast-on
codes.description: Difficulty choosing stitch operation, needle pattern, carriage direction, and securing-row structure.

codes.label: Binding and using the carrier
codes.description: Revision of carrier identifiers, declarations, or scope to obtain consistent carrier use.

codes.label: Coordinating releasehook and rows
codes.description: Difficulty positioning releasehook relative to securing and body rows.

codes.label: Choosing an initial program structure
codes.description: Difficulty turning an initial needle idea into a workable width, carrier, direction, and cast-on scaffold.

codes.label: Distinguishing KnitScript from Python
codes.description: Python imports, calls, arguments, or print debugging appear before returning to KnitScript.

codes.label: Distinguishing knitout from KnitScript
codes.description: Generated knitout is pasted into the editor, tested, cleared, and replaced by KnitScript.

codes.label: Matching width and row structure
codes.description: Difficulty aligning pattern dimensions and repeated rows with task requirements.
